title: Correct Ding
blurb: Crisp, civilised, and entirely satisfied with itself. Where the loud buzzer screams that you are wrong, this simply confirms that you are right and moves on — quiz-show official, no fuss, no celebration beyond what the occasion warrants. That restraint is what makes it so pleasant to trigger repeatedly. Use it for trivia nights, teaching moments, and dignifying the small daily victories nobody else is going to acknowledge: the right platform, the correct change, remembering a name on the second attempt. The gold star of sounds, ready on demand.
origin: The classic right-answer chime of quiz culture.
